lines.text: Many learners say: I have met her last week.
Better: I met her last week.
Last week is finished. Use met.
Met! I met him last year.

data.wrong: I have met her last week.
data.why: Last week is finished. Use met.

native.tip: 中文“我上周见过她”里的“过”容易让人用 have met，但有明确的过去时间要用一般过去式。
native.caption: 你是不是也会说 “I have met her last week.”😅 受“见过她”中的“过”影响，很多人会用 have met；但句子里有“上周”这种明确的过去时间，就要用 met：“I met her last week.”跟着 Ama 老师读一读！在 Lexkite 应用里练习更多。

en.tip: With a finished time like last week, use the simple past: met.
en.caption: Do you say “I have met her last week.” 😅 With a finished time like last week, use the simple past: “I met her last week.” Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
